normalization_rules: Do not infer source variable names from labels or literature summaries.
Freeze household partition from IDs before joining outcomes.
Export only development households to normalized JSONL; do not export reserve outcomes.
Reject uncertain timing and post-lottery survey attitudes as pretreatment covariates.
Document exclusions and weights from source code before approving contract.
If the full published sample is analyzed for reproduction, label it historical development; do not claim that sample contains a pristine confirmation holdout.
